youtubeTitle: She lost her sight in childhood. Two decades later, she became the officer running the show.
caption:
She lost her sight in childhood. Two decades later, she became the officer running the show.

Pranjal Patil, from Ulhasnagar, Maharashtra, lost her eyesight in childhood and studied at a school for the blind before earning a postgraduate degree in International Relations from Jawaharlal Nehru University. She cracked the UPSC Civil Services Examination without any coaching, using text-to-speech software to study, improving from rank 744 in 2016 to rank 124 in 2017. In 2018 she became India's first fully visually-impaired woman IAS officer, later serving as Sub-Collector of Thiruvananthapuram and pushing for more accessible government offices.
